{{Quote|It's hard to say. There are as many Bosses on Wielu as there are islands. Could be Boss Kroperdin, Boss Caylagos, Boss Traygura...|Rook Pryce lists some of the criminal bosses of Wielu|<ref name="SC">''[[The Clone Wars: The Smuggler's Code]]''</ref>}}
'''Kroperdin''' was a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime boss]] who operated on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Wielu]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. At some point, a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] named [[Rook Pryce]] worked for Kroperdin, a fact he mentioned to the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] when the pair were searching for the [[Shistavanen/Legends|Shistavanen]] criminal [[T'mott Zoat]]. The Shistavanen was working for a crime boss on Wielu and Pryce suggested the boss might be Kroperdin, with other potential bosses including [[Caylagos]] and [[Traygura]].<ref name="SC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kroperdin was first mentioned in ''[[The Clone Wars: The Smuggler's Code]]'', a digest sized [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] written by [[Justin Aclin]] that was released in [[2013]].<ref name="SC" />
